data.title: 灰姑娘 · 幽蓝丝绸旗袍开衩间的屏风幽会
data.description: 幽静寝殿的刺绣屏风后，灰姑娘身着一袭极高开叉的暗蓝丝绸旗袍斜坐雕花木榻。旗袍侧边盘扣解开数枚，白玉般的修长美腿无遮袒露，她玉手轻扶榻沿，微扬着高傲的天鹅颈，红眸中满是压抑不住的温热渴望。
data.location: 中式典雅行宫屏风后的雕花暖榻
data.action: 侧卧暖榻，旗袍侧衩轻撩，仰颈喘息凝视
data.lighting: 屏风旁宫灯透出的微弱暖黄烛光
data.promptProse: Reclining along the lacquered settee behind the silk screen, the side slit of her dark blue cheongsam parts along her porcelain thigh. Lantern light glimmers along her arched collarbone as she breathes softly into the stillness.
data.animaCaption: She reclines on the carved couch with her silk cheongsam slit parted, breathing softly.
